gsm8k.authors: Cobbe et al. (2021), Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems

commonsenseqa.authors: Talmor, Herzig, Lourie and Berant (2019), CommonsenseQA

duplicate_overlap_audit.exclusion_rule: Exclude every cross-original-split/domain overlapping group; keep first pinned row for within-split duplicates before seeded selection.

dataset_selection.selection_rule: Select by seeded permutation of independent canonical question groups before any model outcomes; one initial/recheck pair per selected question.
dataset_selection.canonicalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace; SHA256 of full question including all choice options.
dataset_selection.source_question_ids: GSM8K has no released question ID: pinned Parquet row offset; CommonsenseQA uses its published id.
dataset_selection.rounding_rule: Floor maths train=3N/5 and development=N/5; remainder test. Floor target adaptation=2N/5; remainder test.
repartition_notes: GSM8K train is repartitioned into study training/development without using outcomes; its original test remains held out.
CommonsenseQA labeled training questions supply adaptation only. Labeled validation supplies this study's fixed target test; official test answer keys are withheld and that split is not used.
This is a new fixed-solver self-rechecking experiment, not reproduction of the original benchmark leaderboard or SEVRA outcomes.
GSM8K replaces the public pilot's MATH source because its public numeric keys support transparent deterministic offline scoring.
The planned sample sizes are collection targets and do not guarantee enough rare HURT events or statistical reliability.
dataset_selection.question_format_version: GSM8K original question; CommonsenseQA stem plus labeled A-E options and one-letter response instruction-v1
dataset_selection.key_separation: Question manifest contains no answers/solutions/correctness. Trusted keys are used offline only and are never passed to model prompts or predictor inputs.
dataset_selection.raw_downloads: Local raw/ snapshots are provenance caches and must be excluded from diagnostic bundles.

recorded_status.probabilities: Uncalibrated three-class classifier outputs, not correctness probabilities.
limitations: Five genuine source-training examples per outcome class is only an eligibility floor, not evidence of research reliability. Class weights create no new rare events.

Frozen explicit-final-v1 normalization uses Decimal precision 28. Only exact finite decimal values and fractions exactly representable at that precision are accepted as reliable numeric evidence. This validation does not relabel records; precision-preserving grading needs a new version.

Policy tokens and reconstructed latency use the successful initial/recheck calls of completed pairs. They exclude failed/retried call work and its unknown token usage; collection elapsed time and failure counts must be reported separately. They are not complete collection cost or measured live end-to-end latency.

predeclared.model_selection_rule: Fit on source training only. Select the highest question-equal source-development macro-F1; ties (12 decimal places) use lower question-equal multiclass log loss, then the fixed candidate order. No target labels are used for model selection.
predeclared.threshold_selection_rule: Question-equal HELP minus HURT utility on source development only; ties use fewer recorded recheck tokens, then the larger threshold. Strict score > threshold.
